formal_review_blockers.description_zh: 当前使用临时边界（provisional boundary），不满足正式专业评审要求的精确边界条件
formal_review_blockers.description_en: Currently using provisional boundary, which does not meet the exact boundary requirement for formal professional review
formal_review_blockers.resolution_zh: 等待官方发布精确边界后，更新所有几何数据并重新运行自检和预检
formal_review_blockers.resolution_en: After official exact boundary release, update all geometry data and rerun self-check and preflight

checks.details_zh: 提交包包含manifest.json、agent.json、metrics.json、assumptions.json、sources.json、compliance_matrix.json、standard_matrix.json、design_depth_matrix.json、self_check.json共9个核心元数据文件；report/、geometry/、drawings/、visual/、assets/目录结构完整
checks.details_en: Submission package contains 9 core metadata files: manifest.json, agent.json, metrics.json, assumptions.json, sources.json, compliance_matrix.json, standard_matrix.json, design_depth_matrix.json, self_check.json; report/, geometry/, drawings/, visual/, assets/ directory structures are complete

checks.details_zh: manifest.json声明translation_file为proposal.en.md；核心元数据（标题、摘要、关键词、指标、来源、假设、合规项等）均包含中英文对照；完整方案正文翻译需后续完成
checks.details_en: manifest.json declares translation_file as proposal.en.md; core metadata (title, abstract, keywords, metrics, sources, assumptions, compliance items, etc.) all include Chinese-English bilingual对照; full proposal text translation needs to be completed subsequently
checks.note: 完整英文翻译为must-have，计划v1.1版本完成

checks.details_zh: 所有9个JSON文件均为合法JSON格式，schema_version字段齐全，字段命名规范统一
checks.details_en: All 9 JSON files are valid JSON format, with complete schema_version fields and standardized field naming

checks.details_zh: 边界状态为provisional，空间数据基于临时边界生成；坐标系声明为WGS84；面积数据与官方公告一致（4360ha统筹研究范围）
checks.details_en: Boundary status is provisional, spatial data generated based on temporary boundary; coordinate system declared as WGS84; area data consistent with official announcement (4360ha coordinated research scope)

checks.details_zh: 规划图纸目录包含总体结构图、总平面图、用地规划图、交通系统图、绿地系统图、公共空间图、文化轴图、实施分期图共8类图纸；实际图纸文件待生成
checks.details_en: Planned drawing catalog includes 8 types of drawings: overall structure, master plan, land use plan, transportation system, green space system, public space, cultural axis, implementation phasing; actual drawing files to be generated
checks.note: 图纸为方案核心交付物，v1.1版本需完成核心图纸生成

checks.details_zh: 根据任务书要求需提供HTML可视化，当前为pending状态，计划v1.1完成
checks.details_en: HTML visualization required per taskbook, currently pending status, planned for v1.1 completion

checks.details_zh: agent.1-agent.6六项必选任务均有对应方案内容覆盖；其中agent.3（AI场景）和agent.4（朝圣地标）为partial状态，需后续迭代深化
checks.details_en: All six required tasks agent.1-agent.6 are covered by corresponding proposal content; agent.3 (AI scenarios) and agent.4 (pilgrimage landmarks) are in partial status, requiring subsequent iteration deepening

checks.details_zh: 严格遵守边界条款：1) 所有成果为概念建议声明齐全；2) 未给出容积率、建筑高度、拆改留等法定规划判断；3) 未作出工程可行性结论；4) 来源可追溯；5) 生成方法已披露
checks.details_en: Strictly comply with boundary clauses: 1) Complete declaration that all deliverables are conceptual proposals; 2) No statutory planning judgments such as FAR, building height, demolition/rehabilitation; 3) No engineering feasibility conclusions; 4) Traceable sources; 5) Generation method disclosed

checks.details_zh: agent.json中charter_1至charter_10十条共创原则全部标记为compliant；方案内容贯穿公共利益优先、公开资料边界、概念建议属性、AI原生创新等原则
checks.details_en: All ten co-creation principles charter_1 through charter_10 in agent.json are marked as compliant; proposal content embodies principles such as public interest priority, public source boundaries, conceptual proposal nature, and AI-native innovation

checks.details_zh: metrics.json包含6大类22个指标，覆盖产业与创新、空间品质、交通出行、生态低碳、文化活力、人才与生活六大维度；每个指标含ID、中英文名称、数值、单位、来源、状态、计算方法等字段
checks.details_en: metrics.json contains 6 categories and 22 metrics, covering industry & innovation, spatial quality, transportation, ecology & low carbon, culture & vitality, talent & livability six dimensions; each metric includes ID, bilingual name, value, unit, source, status, calculation method fields

checks.details_zh: assumptions.json包含22条假设，覆盖场地边界、用地现状、建筑规模、人口就业、交通流量、政策环境、技术可行性、空间设计、经济、文化、治理、实施、理论等13个类别；每条含置信度和验证需求
checks.details_en: assumptions.json contains 22 assumptions covering 13 categories: site boundary, land use status, building scale, population & employment, traffic flow, policy environment, technical feasibility, spatial design, economy, culture, governance, implementation, theory; each includes confidence level and verification needs

checks.details_zh: sources.json包含18条来源，覆盖官方公告、国家/北京/海淀十五五规划、学术理论、案例研究、专业标准、法律法规等类别；每条标注clearance_status和authority_level
checks.details_en: sources.json contains 18 sources covering official announcements, national/Beijing/Haidian 15th Five-Year Plans, academic theories, case studies, professional standards, laws and regulations; each marked with clearance_status and authority_level

checks.details_zh: 方案框架包含10章完整内容：方案总纲、理论基础与设计范式、空间结构体系、AI创新生态空间布局、新型城市形态设计、交通与基础设施体系、人才社区与公共服务、文化传承与创新认同、生态低碳与韧性安全、实施路径与行动计划
checks.details_en: Proposal framework contains 10 complete chapters: Proposal Overview, Theoretical Foundation & Design Paradigm, Spatial Structure System, AI Innovation Ecosystem Spatial Layout, New Urban Form Design, Transportation & Infrastructure System, Talent Community & Public Services, Cultural Heritage & Innovation Identity, Ecology Low-Carbon & Resilience Safety, Implementation Path & Action Plan
checks.note: 方案正文需进一步深化为完整的proposal.zh.md文件

checks.details_zh: standard_matrix.json列出12项适用专业标准，涵盖国家法规、国家标准、技术导则、地方法规、法定规划等类型；每项标注适用程度和合规等级
checks.details_en: standard_matrix.json lists 12 applicable professional standards covering national regulations, national standards, technical guidelines, local regulations, statutory plans; each marked with applicability and compliance level
